question.text: A thin circular ring of mass $\mathrm{m}$ and radius $\mathrm{R}$ is rotating about its axis with a constant angular velocity $\omega$. Two objects each of mass $M$ are attached gently to the opposite ends of a diameter of the ring. The ring now rotates with an angular velocity $\omega^{\prime}=$

solution.text:
$L_i=L_f$
$m R R^2 \omega=\left(m R^2+2 M R^2\right) \omega^{\prime}$
$\omega^{\prime}=\left(\frac{m \omega}{m+2 M}\right)$
